replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: This is absolutely spam and it's not limited to this sub, you are spamming your low effort game posts all over reddit.

replies.author: Novel-Common9013
replies.body: The character uses generative AI as part of the pipeline but the game itself isn't "just AI art." Most of the work is programming, gameplay systems, animation, level design, sound, balancing, and years of iteration since 2022.

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: I never said any of that. I said you're spamming low effort posts everywhere.

replies.author: Dev_LegendsofAerthos
replies.body: The delusion is strong with this one

replies.author: Mataric
replies.body:
There's also straight lies in most of his marketing. No part of this was 'the first AI game' or 'the first game to use AI', nor is it using AI in any way that hasn't been used in games prior to it.

I appreciate that lie is like.. the only thing that makes his game special - but it's a real shitty look for most of us when the people publicising their AI games are just lying to potential customers.
